97.title: have got 与 belong to
97.chat: have got 就是 have：It's got a zip.（它带拉链）。「属于某人」用 belong to：This case doesn't belong to me.（这箱子不是我的）。描述东西时形容词有排队规则：大小 → 颜色 → 名词。
97.formula: a + 大小 + 颜色 + 名词：a small blue case ｜ belong to + 人

examples.en: It's a small blue case and it's got a zip.
examples.cn: 是只蓝色小箱子，带拉链。

examples.en: Can you describe it?
This case doesn't belong to me!

97.watch: belong to 后面跟人或 me/him：belong to me ✓ belong to my ❌！

99.title: 反身代词与三态同形
99.chat: 动作落在自己身上，要用反身代词：hurt yourself（伤到你自己）。hurt 这个词三态同形：hurt-hurt-hurt，过去式不用变！「我确信……」：I'm sure (that)…
99.formula: hurt oneself 伤到自己 ｜ I'm sure (that) + 句子

examples.en: Have you hurt yourself?
I think that I've hurt my back.
I'm sure that you need an X-ray.

99.watch: 三态同形小家族：hurt / hit / cut——过去式和原形长得一模一样！

101.title: says that：转述刚说的话
101.chat: 把别人说的话转告给别人，用 He says (that) + 原话。小 that 可以省略，引号也不需要了，时态跟原话保持一致。

examples.en: He says he's just arrived in Scotland.
He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel.
examples.cn: 他说他住在青年招待所。

examples.en: He says he'll write a letter soon.

101.watch: say 后面不接人；要接人说 tell：He tells me…（他告诉我……）！

103.title: too 与 enough：一前一后
103.chat: too 和 enough 都管「程度」，位置正好相反：too + 形容词（太……而做不到），形容词 + enough（足够……）。「我认为……」用 I think (that)…
103.formula: too + 形容词（太……）｜ 形容词 + enough（足够……）

examples.en: The paper wasn't easy enough for me.
examples.cn: 试卷对我来说不够容易。

examples.en: They were too difficult for me.
I think I passed.

103.watch: enough 永远跟在形容词后面：easy enough ✓ enough easy ❌！

105.title: want sb to do sth
105.chat: 要「某人去做某事」，公式是 want + 人 + to + 动词原形：I want her to come to my office.（我要她来我办公室）。「犯错误」固定说 make a mistake。
105.formula: want + 人 + to + 动词原形（要某人做……）

examples.en: I want her to type this letter again.
examples.cn: 我要她把这封信再打一遍。

examples.en: Tell her to come at once.
You've made seventeen mistakes.

105.watch: to 后面的动作是「对方」做的：I want you to spell it. 是要「你」来拼，不是我拼！

107.title: 比较级：谁更……
107.chat: 比较两个东西，用比较级：短形容词 + er + than。pretty 变 y 为 i 加 er：prettier；big 双写 g：bigger。too…for me = 对我来说太……
107.formula: A + 形容词er + than + B（A 比 B 更……）

examples.en: It's a lovely dress, but it's too small for me.
examples.cn: 裙子很漂亮，但我穿太小。

examples.en: Short skirts are in fashion now.
This one's prettier than that one.

109.title: Shall I…? 与 a little/a few
109.chat: 主动提出帮忙：Shall I…?（我来……好吗？）。「一点」分两种：a little 配不可数名词（a little milk 一点牛奶），a few 配可数名词（a few biscuits 几块饼干）。
109.formula: Shall I + 动词…? ｜ a little + 不可数 ／ a few + 可数

examples.en: Shall I make some coffee, Jane?
Just a little, please.
What a pity!

109.watch: advice（建议）不可数：a piece of advice ✓ an advice ❌！

111.title: 最高级：谁最……
111.chat: 三个以上比高低，用最高级：多音节形容词用 the most（the most expensive 最贵的）；「不如……贵」用 less expensive。付不起说 can't afford。
111.formula: the most + 形容词（最……）｜ less + 形容词 + than（不如……）

examples.en: It's the most expensive model in the shop.
This model's less expensive than that one.
We can't afford all that money.

111.watch: 比较级 → 最高级三兄弟：more → the most；prettier → the prettiest！

113.title: Neither can I：我也不
113.chat: 回应别人的否定情况，把 Neither 提到最前面，后面的词序要「倒」过来：Neither can I.（我也不能）。none 表示「一个也没有」：I've got none.
113.formula: Neither + 助动词 + 主语 = ……也不 ｜ none = 一个也没有

examples.en: I can't change a ten-pound note.
Neither can I.
Haven't you got any small change?

113.watch: 回应否定用 Neither have I / Neither can I（我也<不>……）；Me too 是回应肯定句的！

115.title: 复合不定代词都是「单数」
115.chat: anyone（任何人）、nobody（没人）、everything（一切）这些词虽然意思像「很多」，但都当单数用：Everything's quiet.（一切都很安静）。修饰它们的词要放在后面。
115.formula: everyone / anyone / nobody / nothing + 单数动词 ｜ 修饰语后置

examples.en: Isn't there anyone at home?
Everything's very quiet.
Everyone's in the garden.

115.watch: 形容词后置：something nice（好东西）。anyone 常用于疑问、否定语境，someone 也可用于期待肯定回答的问句；本课原句用 anyone，不是说所有问句都必须用它。

117.title: 过去进行时：过去的「直播」
117.chat: 过去进行时 = was/were + 动词ing，表示「过去那一刻正在做」。讲故事时：长动作用进行时当背景，短动作用过去式突然打断——when/while 负责报时！
117.formula: was/were + 动词ing（过去正在……）｜ when/while + 从句

examples.en: When my husband was going into the dining room, he dropped some coins.
examples.cn: 丈夫走进饭厅时，硬币掉在了地上。

examples.en: While we were having breakfast, Tommy found two small coins.
examples.cn: 我们吃早饭时，汤米找到了两枚硬币。

117.watch: 长动作（was going）当背景，短动作（dropped）是主角——进行时负责「画面」，过去式负责「事件」！

119.title: happen to 与 as…as
119.chat: happen（发生）后面用 to 接人：It happened to me.（发生在我身上）。「尽可能快」= as quickly as they could（as…as 中间放副词）。happen 没有被动语态！
119.formula: happen to sb 发生在某人身上 ｜ as + 副词 + as one can = 尽可能……

examples.en: It happened to a friend of mine a year ago.
examples.cn: 这是一年前发生在我朋友身上的事。

examples.en: They ran away as quickly as they could.
What's up?

119.watch: happen 不能用被动：It was happened ❌ → It happened ✓！

121.title: 定语从句：贴在名词后的说明
121.chat: 想给名词加一段说明（……的那个人/东西），用定语从句。本课用 who/that 说明人、which 说明物：The lady who is standing behind the counter.（站在柜台后面的女士。）接待顾客的是卡罗琳，戴帽子的是顾客。
121.formula: 本课：人 + who/that + 说明 ｜ 物 + which + 说明

examples.en: Who served you, sir?
The lady who is standing behind the counter.
examples.cn: 站在柜台后面的那位女士。

examples.en: The books which are on the counter.

121.watch: 从句是名词的「小尾巴」，必须紧贴在名词后面，不能甩到句尾哦！

123.title: during 与过去式拍档
123.chat: during + 名词表示「在……期间」：during the trip（旅行期间）。两个新过去式：grow→grew（grow a beard 留胡子）、shave…off（刮掉）。
123.formula: during + 名词（在……期间）｜ grow a beard 留胡子 ｜ shave it off 刮掉

examples.en: This is a photograph I took during my trip to Australia.
examples.cn: 这是我在澳大利亚旅行期间拍的一张照片。

examples.en: I grew a beard during the trip.
But I shaved it off when I came home.

123.watch: during + 名词，while + 句子：during the trip = while I was travelling！

125.title: have to 与 needn't 再登场
125.chat: have to 表示「客观上不得不」（三单变 has to）；「不必」是 needn't！再强调一次：mustn't 是「禁止」，needn't 才是「不必」，这对兄弟总在考试出现！
125.formula: have to = 不得不 ｜ needn't = 不必 ｜ mustn't = 禁止

examples.en: Do you have to water it now?
I'm afraid I do. It's terribly dry.
You needn't water the garden.

125.watch: 感叹句公式：What a + 名词！What a nuisance!（真讨厌！）What a pity!（真遗憾！）

127.title: must be：有把握的推测
127.chat: 看到证据猜年龄，用 must be（肯定是）：She must be at least forty.（她肯定至少40岁）。发表看法用 In my opinion…（依我看）。
127.formula: must be = 一定是（很有把握）｜ may be = 可能是 ｜ can't be = 不可能是

examples.en: She must be at least forty.
examples.cn: 她一定至少有四十岁了。

examples.en: I read she's twenty-nine, but she must be at least forty.
examples.cn: 我读到她是二十九岁，但她一定至少有四十岁了。

examples.en: She was a famous actress when I was still at school.
examples.cn: 我还在上学时，她就已经是著名的女演员了。

127.watch: 推测三档口诀：must be 肯定是 → may be 也许是 → can't be 不可能是！

129.title: 推测过去：must have been
129.chat: 推测「过去肯定发生了什么」，用 must have been / must have been doing：You must have been driving at seventy.（你当时肯定开到70迈了）。否定推测用 can't have been.
129.formula: must have been…（过去一定是）｜ can't have been…（过去不可能）

examples.en: You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.
examples.cn: 你当时一定以每小时70英里行驶。

examples.en: I can't have been.
I was doing eighty when I overtook you.

129.watch: 说「以……速度」用介词 at：drive at seventy miles an hour！

131.title: may / might：可能性
131.chat: 不太确定的事用 may 或 might + 动词原形：We may go abroad.（我们可能出国）。might 比 may 把握更小。「担心……」用 worry about。abroad 是副词，前面不加 to！
131.formula: may / might + 动词原形 = 可能……

examples.en: We may go abroad.
My wife wants to go to Egypt, so I may go there.
examples.cn: 我妻子想去埃及，所以我可能去那儿。

examples.en: My wife always worries too much.

131.watch: go abroad 出国 ✓ go to abroad ❌——abroad 前面千万不要 to！

133.title: 转述过去：时态后退一步
133.chat: 把过去说的话转述给别人，时态要「后退一步」：am/is going to → was going to。She said she was going to retire.（她说她准备退休。）say 后不接人，tell 后必须接人！
133.formula: She said (that) she was going to… ｜ She told me (that)…

examples.en: Have you just made a new film, Miss Marsh?
examples.cn: 马什小姐，您刚拍完新电影吗？

examples.en: She said she was going to retire.
I wonder why!

133.watch: 直接引语变转述：I'm tired → She said she was tired.（am 后退成 was）！

135.title: 转述将来：will 变 would
135.chat: 转述「将来的打算」，will 要变成 would：She said she would ask her future husband.（她说她会问未婚夫）。get married = 结婚；最新的 = the latest。
135.formula: said (that) + 主语 + would + 动词原形

examples.en: Are you really going to retire?
I can't make up my mind.
She said she would have to ask her future husband.

135.watch: would 是 will 的过去式：I will… → He said he would…——总是后退一步！

137.title: if 条件句：主将从现
137.chat: 真实的假设用 if 条件句，口诀「主将从现」：if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will：If we win, we'll travel round the world.（如果赢了，我们就环游世界。）
137.formula: If + 一般现在时, 主语 + will + 动词原形

examples.en: What will you do if you win a lot of money?
examples.cn: 如果你赢了很多钱，你会做什么？

examples.en: If we win the pools, we'll travel round the world.
examples.cn: 如果我们赢了，我们就环游世界。

examples.en: If we spend all the money we'll be poor again.
examples.cn: 把钱花光我们又会变穷的。

137.watch: if 后面绝对不能用 will：If we'll win ❌ → If we win ✓——这就是「主将从现」！

139.title: 电话用语：Is that…?
139.chat: 英语打电话问「你是……吗」用 Is that…?，回答 Yes, speaking.（我是，请讲）。转告某人一件事：tell + 人 + (that) + 内容。
139.formula: Is that…(名字)? → Yes, speaking. ｜ tell + 人 + (that) + 句子

examples.en: Is that you, John?
Yes, speaking.
Tell Mary we'll be late for dinner this evening.
examples.cn: 告诉玛丽，今晚吃饭我们会晚到。

139.watch: 电话开场介绍自己常用 This is…；本课核实姓名时也说 Yes, I’m John Smith.。格雷厄姆认错了同名的人，接电话的是正在修理线路的电话工程师。

141.title: 被动语态与过去完成时
141.chat: 动作「落在」主语头上，用被动语态：was invited（被邀请）= be + 过去分词。过去完成时 had done 表示「过去的过去」：她上车之前从未坐过火车 → She had never travelled by train before.
141.formula: was/were + 过去分词（被……）｜ had + 过去分词（过去以前就……）

examples.en: Sally was invited to a children's party.
examples.cn: 萨莉被邀请参加儿童聚会。

examples.en: She had never travelled on a train before.
She sat opposite Sally.

141.watch: excited 人感到兴奋，exciting 事物令人兴奋：Sally was excited.（萨莉很兴奋）！

143.title: 被动语态大集合（毕业课）
143.chat: 本课回顾几种被动表达：is surrounded（被环绕）、have been asked（已被要求）、will be prosecuted（将被依法检控）。which 也可以补充说明名词：a sign which said…（一块写着……的牌子）。
143.formula: is/are + 过去分词 ｜ have/has been + 过去分词 ｜ will be + 过去分词

examples.en: The town is surrounded by beautiful woods.
examples.cn: 小镇被美丽的树林环绕。

examples.en: Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean.
examples.cn: 游客已被要求保持树林整洁。

examples.en: Anyone who leaves litter will be prosecuted!
examples.cn: 乱扔垃圾者将被依法处置！

143.watch: surrounded by woods 表示“被树林环绕”；by 在这里引出周围的事物。先理解课文，再分句复习，不必一次背全所有形式。
